description: This file defines the PlayerFragment class, a Fragment subclass managing video playback using ExoPlayer and UI controls for an Android TV app. It handles lifecycle events, player initialization and release, key event handling for remote controls, and media item setup.

classes.name: PlayerFragment
classes.description: A Fragment managing video playback with ExoPlayer, handling lifecycle, media setup, and remote control interactions for Android TV.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes PlayerView, sets focus and key event listener, and configures view properties.

methods.name: buildMediaItem
methods.description: Constructs a MediaItem with appropriate MIME type based on URL extension.

methods.name: initializePlayer
methods.description: Creates and starts ExoPlayer, binds it to PlayerView, and prepares media for playback.

methods.name: releasePlayer
methods.description: Releases ExoPlayer resources and clears PlayerView's player reference.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes player on start, respecting API level for timing.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Brings PlayerView to front and initializes player if needed, respecting API level.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases player if API level mandates on pause.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases player on stop for devices with API >= 24.
